data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is my top overall recommendation.** It offers a good balance of competitive transaction fees, easy integration, security, and room to grow.

However, the best choice depends heavily on which ecommerce platform you use.

## Best payment processors compared

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Typical US online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent integrations and fraud prevention
- Great for independent websites and WooCommerce.
  
  Best for flexibility and growth.
  
  [Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Typical US Basic online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies refunds, reporting, and checkout
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.
  
  [Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best for customer familiarity)

- Fees vary by checkout method
- Familiar and trusted checkout option
- Supports PayPal and other payment options
- Good as an additional payment method.
  
  [PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

(Best for online and in-person sales)

- Online fees depend on plan
- Easy setup
- Combines online and physical payments
- Useful if you also sell at markets or retail locations.
  
  [Square website](https://squareup.com/us/en)

[www.nerdwallet.com](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techcognate.com](https://www.techcognate.com/best-payment-gateways-for-ecommerce/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a new online store | Stripe |
| Already using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Using WordPress/WooCommerce | Stripe or WooPayments |
| Want customers to pay with PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Processing high sales volume | Compare Helcim |


One important tip: I would generally offer **both credit/debit cards and PayPal** rather than relying on just one payment option. This gives customers more flexibility.
